title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 06 May 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 05 May 2026 The Intertropical Convergence Zone (where winds from the Northern Hemisphere and Southern Hemisphere converge) affects the island’s weather. As a result, an increase in rainfall is expected over the island from tomorrow (06). Showers or thundershowers will occur at most places of the island after 1.00 pm. Cloudy skies will prevail over the Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, Southern and Uva provinces and in Ampara district. Morning showers are also expected in these areas. Heavy falls above 100 mm are likely at some places in Sabaragamuwa, Central and Uva provinces and in Ampara, Batticaloa, Galle, Matara and Polonnaruwa districts. Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central, Sabaragamuwa and Uva provinces during the early hours of the morning. The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
